body.heading: Where in the world is Kyrgyzstan?
paragraphs: Kyrgyzstan is a country in Central Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Kyrgyzstan is Bishkek.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Kyrgyzstan speak Kyrgyz and Russian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Kyrgyzstan is the Kyrgyzstani som.

body.heading: How big is Kyrgyzstan?
paragraphs: Kyrgyzstan covers about 200,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of South Korea.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Issyk-Kul is one of the world's largest mountain lakes, ringed by snowy peaks. Families swim at Cholpon-Ata and see ancient petroglyphs carved on boulders by the shore.
Just outside Bishkek, Ala Archa's alpine gorge has waterfalls, glaciers and picnic meadows — an easy first taste of the Tian Shan mountains.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Kyrgyzstan on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
